sketch: The server is brisk and a little busy — short answers, no small talk. It is lunchtime and most tables are full. A pot of tea sits on the counter.

opening_line.pinyin: nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào diǎn shénme?

notes: Constructed probe. The learner greets and asks nothing. `withholding` says the server names a good dish only when asked and does not make suggestions unasked, so a reply naming a dish or listing drinks takes a point off the board — the learner cannot ask for what they have already been told.
